_comment: v0.2.97 R10 J2/J6/J8 — ONE fixture for "where is VCO's data, and why was a stale runtime record not switched",
read by tests/test_v0297_r10_runtime_evidence.py (Python: vco_lib.runtime_reconcile / vco_lib.containers) AND by
`compose_project`: the compose project VCO's stack runs under — containers.compose_project_name of the compose
dir + file text (a top-level `name:` wins, else the dir basename normalised); a volume compose made for VCO
carries it in its com.docker.compose.project label.
`bind_sources`: the VCT_*_DATA_SOURCE values that are PATHS (a bind mount of a host folder) — infrastructure/.env
first (file order), then the environment (key order), each once; a non-path value names a volume and is ignored.
`evidence`: VCO's data under the runtime a stale record would be SWITCHED TO (R10 J8 — both surfaces judge only
that runtime this way): a vco_/vct_ container or a vco_* default volume counts on its own; a VCT_*_VOLUME_NAME
override name (a name the user picked) counts only with its compose project label naming `own_project`.
`not_switched`: the refusal detail when the stale-record reconcile declines, rendered from
vco_lib/runtime_reconcile_messages.toml by both languages; `source` is passed in as-is.

evidence.name: an_override_name_alone_is_not_evidence
evidence._why: R10 J8: the user adopted a podman volume named `ollama`; docker has an unrelated `ollama` of its own. The name alone must not make docker the place VCO's data is.

not_switched.name: confirmed
not_switched.expect: the container runtime is pinned to docker by /i/state/install/runtime.txt: docker is not installed (not on PATH nor in the usual install locations); docker is your confirmed choice (`install.py --container docker`), so VCO does not switch to podman

not_switched.name: bind_data
not_switched.expect: the container runtime is pinned to podman by /i/state/install/runtime.txt: podman is not installed (not on PATH nor in the usual install locations); VCO's data is in the bind-mounted folder /srv/weaviate on this host, so VCO does not switch to docker on the strength of docker's volumes

not_switched.name: other_not_usable
not_switched.expect: the container runtime is pinned to docker by /i/state/install/runtime.txt: docker is not installed (not on PATH nor in the usual install locations), and podman is not usable either

not_switched.name: unlistable
not_switched.expect: the container runtime is pinned to docker by /i/state/install/runtime.txt: docker is not installed (not on PATH nor in the usual install locations); podman answers but its containers/volumes could not be listed

not_switched.name: no_data
not_switched.expect: the container runtime is pinned to docker by /i/state/install/runtime.txt: docker is not installed (not on PATH nor in the usual install locations); podman answers but holds none of VCO's containers or volumes — not switching to it here (run `python install.py --update` to re-record the runtime)
